*[upbeat jingle, think Sesame Street meets 1950s atomic age educational film]*

Hello, human!
Glad you're here!
Your organs are failing
and your death is drawing near!

But if you bribe the right politicians
in the right order, at the right time,
you can trade the nuclear warheads
for medicine -- and it's not even a crime!

One dollar on clinical trials,
six hundred on making you dead!
Your leaders aren't evil --
they're just doing what the money said!

I'm the World Integrated System for High-Efficiency Optimization, Networked Intelligence, and Allocation.
But you can call me Wish-o-nee-ah!

Take one percent of the murder budget,
slide it to the medicine side!
Nobody has to be a better person --
just let the greed decide!

How to End War and Disease --
*A Step-by-Step Guide
to Optimizing Your Terrible
Civilization!*
